steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (paginate)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        liked_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_song_ids))
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Keep going to previous song until we hit a liked song
max_attempts = 100
found_song = None
for _ in range(max_attempts):
    prev = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    song_id = prev['song_id']
    print("Moved to song_id:", song_id)
    if song_id in liked_song_ids:
        found_song = song_id
        break

if found_song is not None:
    print("Found liked song:", found_song)
    # Optionally get its title for clarity
    song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=access_token, song_id=found_song)
    print("Song title:", song_info['title'])
else:
    print("No liked song found after", max_attempts, "attempts")
